name: Ravenholdt Manor
summary: High in the Hillsbrad mountains, Ravenholdt Manor shelters a guild of thieves and assassins. Lord Jorach Ravenholdt leads them as they hone stealth beyond the authorities’ reach.

sections.title: A Sanctuary in the Shadows
sections.body:
Northwest of Durnholde Keep, a narrow pass winds through a cave to Ravenholdt Manor. The estate stands alone on the border of the Alterac Mountains, under Lord Jorach Ravenholdt’s care. He keeps a disciplined company of rogues, assassins, and intelligence operatives.

A quiet garden and an outdoor arena give them room to practice lockpicking, poison-crafting, and close combat under martial experts such as Master Kang. Those skilled in skullduggery are welcome, but watchful sentries greet clumsy strangers and unwanted visitors with cold suspicion.

sections.title: A Bitter Feud in the Foothills
sections.body: Before the First War, the lands around Ravenholdt Manor belonged to the kingdom of Alterac. The manor’s weathered orange roof tiles still recall that time. After Alterac fell, displaced nobles formed the Syndicate and sought control of the region. Their ambition brought them into conflict with Ravenholdt. Jorach’s followers now fight across Hillsbrad and Alterac to preserve their sovereign haven.

faq.q: How do you reach Ravenholdt Manor?
faq.answer: Travel to the plateau northwest of Durnholde Keep in Hillsbrad Foothills. Near the northern mountains, a little-known dirt path climbs through a hidden cave and emerges on the manor grounds.
Lord Jorach Ravenholdt owns the estate and leads Ravenholdt, a brotherhood of thieves and assassins. Rogues throughout Azeroth hold him in deep respect.

faq.q: Why does Ravenholdt hate the Syndicate?
faq.answer: Both factions trace their roots to the shattered lands of Alterac. The Syndicate’s displaced nobles turn to banditry and lawlessness, while Ravenholdt follows strict discipline to thwart their ambitions.

Travelers can walk onto the grounds, where guards and assassins greet outsiders with open hostility. Rogues and trusted operatives receive a warm welcome and extensive training; others are warned to leave.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can find rigorous trials, specialized training, and a deep network of underground contacts at Ravenholdt Manor, a foremost sanctuary for your profession.
As an engineer, you can travel through the mountain pass and seek the rare schematic for the Gnomish Cloaking Device among the manor’s supplies.
